newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France says no cargo yet on Pt.Harcourt flight.
newsitem.headline: Air France says no cargo yet on Pt.Harcourt flight.

text.p: Air France's weekly non-stop passenger service from Paris to Nigeria's Port Harcourt, will not be carrying freight until an unspecified, later date, an Air France cargo official told Reuters.
The service, launched on January 21, is being operated by a Boeing 747-200 combi which can carry around 35 tonnes of freight per flight.
"We need to have assurances on a number of issues, among them security measures, before adding Port Harcourt to our cargo network," the official said.

Air France already operates three combi flights per week between Paris and Lagos, with a large part of the freight carried comprising goods for the Nigerian oil exploration sector he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax 5017
